ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; concentrated vertical black pigment band originating at the median notch and extending ventrally; sparse black circular mottling distributed across the right lobe upper quadrant and left lobe lower margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations along the full length of the trailing edge; extreme jaggedness and peak-density observed on the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity pixel clusters localized on the upper-right lobe surface; small cluster of circular marks on the far left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the central ventral surface horizontally and diagonally, particularly dense near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks and possible rake-derived scarring across the central fluke; significant irregular loss of edge tissue (notching) on the outer distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark vertical pigmentation streak bisecting the central fluke area directly below the median notch.
